title: Vendor number series Default/Manual Nos. fit
purpose: Fix the proven TARGET-036D vendor blocker by inspecting and, if safe, setting only the required U-VEND number-series checkboxes before retrying first vendor creation.

sourceRefs.title: Microsoft Learn: Create number series
sourceRefs.claim: Default Nos. enables automatic numbering; Manual Nos. enables users to enter numbers manually.

requiredCheckboxes: Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. only if the book keeps explicit U-VEND-100 style vendor numbers

entryCriteria: TARGET-036D result exists and shows the vendor card blocker: automatic numbering requires Standardnr. in U-VEND.
TARGET-016M proves U-VEND lines exist with U-VEND00001 to U-VEND99999.
TARGET-017 proves Purchases & Payables Setup / Vendor Nos. contains U-VEND.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND row is not uniquely visible.
Default Nos. / Standardnr. and Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. cannot be mapped to the U-VEND row.
The UI tries to change another number series.
A posting, document, template or unrelated setup route appears.
acceptanceCriteria: Before screenshot shows U-VEND row and checkbox state.
Only U-VEND checkbox state is changed, if any change is needed.
After/reopen screenshot shows the resulting U-VEND Default/Manual Nos. state.
No master data, document, Preview Posting, Posting, Payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.
Result JSON states whether the next vendor write retry should use automatic numbering or explicit U-VEND-100.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036D reached the Vendor Card but BC rejected both manual U-VEND-100 and blank automatic numbering because U-VEND number-series checkboxes are not enabled for the intended route.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Item creation is not the next dependency. The vendor route blocker is a number-series setup issue and must be fixed before continuing master-data sequence.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Directly addresses the proven U-VEND checkbox blocker.
Retry vendor creation only after U-VEND Default/Manual Nos. state is visible after reopen.
Item creation should wait until vendor blocker is closed and item number-series/base-unit route is checked.
Foundation blockers remain relevant before any document flow.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It fixes the exact field-level Business Central blocker proven by TARGET-036D instead of moving to unrelated master data.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not change all number series in bulk.
Do not create a vendor inside the checkbox-fit case.
requiredPreparation: Use screenshot QA so Standardnr. and Manuelle Anz. are visibly tied to the U-VEND row.
